title: Refined Scooba Tank

"Proprietary technology of A.B. Diving. Named after Sir Scoobis III. Quadruples oxygen and allows vehicles to drive underwater. Can be enabled to sink the player to the bottom of the seafloor. (Required to re-enter underwater vehicles)"

The Refined Scooba Tank is an air tank that can be purchased from the River Shop for 150 Credits.

Description

The Refined Scooba Tank quadruples the user's oxygen capacity while it is equipped. It also has the added benefit that, when activated, it causes the user to sink in the water, allowing them to walk around and enter vehicles. The Refined Scooba Tank also allows for vehicles to continue to be operated while underwater, unlike the Rusty Scooba Tank.
